verdict.rationale: ADK documents that it is 'designed to be written by both humans and AI' and lets you 'connect your favorite coding assistant' or 'AI-enabled developer environment' to scaffold, build, test, evaluate, and deploy agents via the Agents CLI and Agent Config (no-code) features, indicating natural-language/AI-native operation of the tooling itself. However, the concrete CLI examples shown (adk run, adk web, adk eval, adk deploy) are still literal shell commands, not natural-language commands, and there's no first-party or independent evidence of a chat/NL interface for operating ADK directly. Missing for 10: direct evidence of a natural-language command interface (vs. structured CLI), independent/hands-on corroboration of the 'AI-aware developer resources' claim.
